description: Claude's finished auto-mode turn closes on 'Want me to do 1 now and prepare the list for 2?' right under a numbered list. A real screen showed the bare question on the phone, with no hint of what 1 and 2 are: the parser returned no supporting table despite the prompt asking for one. classify() now reads the named rows off the screen into question.items (number and first sentence), so the card stands alone; the unnamed optional item 3 stays out. Fictionalized from a live capture.
capture:
[visible screen]
❯ the build box keeps running out of disk, what should I do

  Ran 3 shell commands

● The build box has 6 GB free of 250 GB, and it fills up again within about two days.

  Most of the space goes to three things: old container images (96 GB), the shared
  artifact cache (71 GB), and nightly log bundles nobody reads (38 GB).

  Best things to do, in order:
  1. Prune container images older than 14 days. This is the biggest win and loses
     nothing: every image the current pipelines use was pulled this week, and the rest

  Want me to do 1 now and prepare the list for 2?
